classification.difficultyReason: As p68-q7 but the given angle is exterior and must be converted to 40° first.

content.prompt: Try to find the angle $\theta$ in this triangle; explain why it is impossible.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle ACB&=180^{\circ}-140^{\circ}\\\angle ACB&=40^{\circ}\\\frac{\sin\theta}{9}&=\frac{\sin40^{\circ}}{5}\\\sin\theta&=\frac{9\sin40^{\circ}}{5}\\\sin\theta&\approx1.16\end{align*}$$
This is impossible because a sine value cannot exceed $1$. Therefore there is no possible angle $\theta$, and such a triangle cannot be constructed.
